ns2:section.sectionText: What can we go when the theaters close? What can we do when we can’t make theatre like we used to? This course offers practical strategies for making site-specific performance, whether we’re under quarantine or not. Specifically designed for online learning and the virtual classroom, this iteration of THEA391 features online performance, scavenger hunts, synchronous class discussions, quizzes, videos, and more. At the end of the course, students will be able to Define site-specific Performance, especially for theatre, dance, and performance art Track the history of site-specific performance in the US, the UK, and Canada Produce their own site-specific solo and collaborative performances Understand site-specific performance in the current political, social, and physical climate Let’s make something!
